title: Ulta牵手谷歌：Gemini平台今年上线，美妆购物会怎样？
speaker: Lisa Mateo

segments.en: Alt is using AI to help drive supply chain efficiencies. It's getting the product the right place, the right time, at the right cost for a guest.
segments.zh: Ulta Beauty利用AI提升供应链效率，确保产品在合适的时间、地点以合适成本送达顾客。

segments.en: The company also has a strategic partnership with Google. We're analysis one of their early strategic launch partners for their agenda AI program.
segments.zh: 公司还与谷歌建立战略合作，成为其Agentic AI项目的早期战略发布伙伴之一。

segments.en: And we're excited about bringing the best of the ultra beauty experience to the Google and Gemini platforms later this year.
segments.zh: 我们很高兴能在今年晚些时候将Ulta Beauty的最佳体验带到谷歌和Gemini平台。

segments.en: What's the next big thing in AI for Beauty? Yeah, I think it's, I wouldn't call it the next big thing, but agentic, the opportunity with end-to-end taking something where you can solve a consumer problem or make a process very optimized, that's the opportunity.
segments.zh: AI美妆的下一个大事件是什么？我认为不是大事件，而是智能体，端到端解决消费者问题或优化流程的机会。

segments.en: We just don't chase the next tech trend and over the last three years we've modernized our four operations. We've made significant investment in our guest-facing platforms to deliver that elevated experience.
segments.zh: 我们不追逐技术潮流，过去三年我们现代化了运营，大力建设面向顾客的平台，以提供卓越体验。

segments.en: We've modernized our data platforms and that's really, really, really prepared us well to take on this challenge of AI. And if you take it with that people centric approach, I think you'll do well.
segments.zh: 我们现代化了数据平台，为迎接AI挑战做好了充分准备。如果坚持以人为本，我相信会做得很好。

segments.en: We want to lean in there and explore. I think for us being helpful in the consumer journey is important.
segments.zh: 我们希望深入探索。在消费者旅程中提供帮助对我们来说很重要。
